title: Deep If nesting
description:
Error-prone rule — steps nested five or more If levels deep. Deep conditionals are hard to read and test.

Based on the PMD rule AvoidDeeplyNestedIfStmts — https://docs.pmd-code.org/latest/pmd_rules_java_design.html#avoiddeeplynestedifstmts
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Deeply nested conditionals hide edge cases and are error-prone to change.
rule.remediation: Refactor to guard clauses / early exits, or extract sub-scripts.
